probe_detail.name: Use of the Oxford (serial) comma in lists
Proportion of sentences written in the passive voice
States a concrete limitation or scope condition of its own claim
Gives a mechanism for why the proposed approach should work

final.name: Density of formal vocabulary and mathematical notation on the page
final.audit_justification: It explicitly counts formal-vocabulary/notation markers regardless of correctness, rigor, or whether anything checkable is asserted, so it is a surface density measure rather than a quality judgement, though the underlying mathematical training that produces such density could also produce genuine rigor elsewhere.
final.parent: Extent of formal notation and mathematical vocabulary
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Extent of formal notation and mathematical vocabulary

final.name: Enumerated contribution scaffolding and roadmap phrasing
final.audit_justification: It scores the presence of a formulaic enumerated/roadmap template for presenting contributions and explicitly disclaims judging whether the organisation aids the reader or is good practice, making it a template-phrasing habit with no clear link to underlying quality.
final.upstream_parent: the authors' accumulated practice in this submission format; rubric-aware, reviewer-facing writing habits learned over repeated submission cycles

final.name: Enumeration count of evaluation settings and resource markers
final.audit_justification: It is an explicit count of named settings/resources that must score 10 even if nothing was learned, but the resource abundance that drives such enumeration could plausibly also enable genuinely more thorough work.
final.parent: Count of enumerated evaluation settings and resource markers
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Count of enumerated evaluation settings and resource markers

final.name: Inline mathematical notation and complexity-bound density
final.audit_justification: Like X01 it counts notation/citation-style markers on the page while explicitly disclaiming any judgement of rigor, correctness or whether the formalism is warranted, though the mathematical fluency behind it could plausibly also yield genuine rigor.
final.upstream_parent: writing conventions of the theory-versus-applied subcommunity that produced the work

final.name: Axiomatic Objective Derivation
final.audit_justification: It distinguishes objectives rigorously derived from stated axioms from ones tuned via unprincipled heuristic weighting terms, which is a genuine methodological-soundness judgement a careful expert would credit.

final.name: Extent of coverage listing and breadth vocabulary
final.audit_justification: It explicitly counts listed coverage items plus stock breadth-signalling phrases and must score 10 even for an item that reports only 'consistently outperforms', but resource abundance and genuine thoroughness could plausibly underlie some of that listing.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Evaluation-breadth signaling

final.name: Abstract length / elaboration verbosity
final.audit_justification: It is explicitly a pure word-count/elaboration measure that disclaims judging whether the length is appropriate, though genuinely more substantive multi-contribution papers could plausibly also run longer.

final.name: Foundational tool reusability potential
final.audit_justification: Judging whether a technique is general enough to become a reusable building block versus narrowly coupled to one setting is a substantive significance/generality assessment of the contribution's content.

final.name: Explicit Resource Accounting
final.audit_justification: It requires costs to be quantified and tied to actual design choices rather than asserted with vague adjectives, which is a genuine precision/rigor distinction, not a surface marker.

final.name: Prior approaches shown as special cases
final.audit_justification: Demonstrating that a framework subsumes prior methods as special cases is a genuine theoretical-unification contribution that a careful expert would treat as real evidence of quality.

final.name: Transferable finding about the phenomenon, not only about the artifact
final.audit_justification: It asks whether the abstract states a checkable, durable fact about the phenomenon beyond the specific artifact, which is a genuine scientific-content distinction rather than a surface feature.

final.name: Named large-scale engineering/experimental-resource markers
final.audit_justification: It scores only the presence of named large-scale hardware/scale figures and explicitly disclaims judging whether the scale is impressive or beneficial, though the resourcing behind such figures could plausibly also enable genuinely more rigorous work.
final.upstream_parent: author's institutional resources / access to large-scale compute or experimental infrastructure

final.name: First-Principles Continuous Formulation
final.audit_justification: It rewards a specific technical camp (continuous ODE/PDE derivation) and penalises architectures validated by empirical performance as if that were inherently unprincipled, which is a subfield/topic preference rather than a universal quality standard, though the mathematical sophistication behind it could plausibly also produce genuine rigor elsewhere.
final.arbiter_reason: As written the instruction scores the paper's methodological camp -- continuous ODE/PDE derivation gets 10, empirically-validated discrete architectures get 0 -- so a high score is a topic/subfield marker rather than evidence of research quality, and a rigorous, well-evidenced empirical architecture paper would be floored by it. It is mixed because the mathematical grounding it detects does plausibly co-occur with genuine derivational rigor in some submissions.

final.name: Component-level attribution of contribution
final.audit_justification: Separating component roles and providing evidence each addresses a stated bottleneck versus an unexamined bundled system is a genuine evidentiary/ablation-rigor distinction.

final.name: Precise mechanistic diagnosis before solution
final.audit_justification: Pinpointing the specific mechanism behind a prior failure before proposing a fix, versus a generic problem statement, is a genuine intellectual-rigor distinction about the content of the diagnosis.

final.name: Release and resource signaling
final.audit_justification: It explicitly scores only presence/prominence of release-resource signals and disclaims judging their usefulness, though a practice of releasing code could plausibly also reflect genuinely more reproducible, careful research.
final.upstream_parent: author's reproducibility practice and available resources

final.name: Crowded-field late-synthesis vs first-mover idea framing
final.audit_justification: It scores only the rhetorical framing of arriving late into a crowded field versus presenting a first, direct idea and explicitly disclaims judging whether the positioning is accurate or the synthesis genuine, though a paper actually attempting real unification (rewarded elsewhere as quality) would plausibly also adopt this framing.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream — how many similar prior submissions/approaches already existed when this abstract was framed

final.name: Substantiated range: variation reported across conditions that could differ
final.audit_justification: It explicitly rewards reporting how a result varies across a meaningful dimension and naming a boundary, and explicitly zeroes out mere coverage counts or vocabulary, making it a genuine evidentiary-substance judgement.

final.name: Formal Mathematical Bridging Across Domains
final.audit_justification: It distinguishes a rigorously, formally instantiated cross-domain mapping from a superficial borrowing of loose terminology, which is a genuine rigor-of-connection judgement rather than mere notation presence.

final.name: Cross-regime evidential robustness
final.audit_justification: It requires genuinely different regimes tested with a coherent pattern of support (not mere enumeration) versus evidence from one narrow benchmark, which is a real robustness-of-evidence judgement.

final.name: Precision of the claim, its assumptions, and its failure regime
final.audit_justification: It explicitly credits symbol-free precision about the claim, its conditions, its costs, and its failure regime while explicitly refusing to reward notation, making it a direct measure of genuine epistemic precision.
final.parent: Extent of formal notation and mathematical vocabulary

final.name: Conference Boilerplate Inclusion
final.audit_justification: It measures the volume of accidentally-included administrative boilerplate, an artifact of submission formatting with no plausible connection to research quality.

final.name: Actionable Interpretability
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing interpretability that yields a concrete, actionable design/diagnostic insight from mere visualization is a genuine depth-of-contribution judgement.

final.name: Diagnostic bearing of the evaluation conditions actually described
final.audit_justification: It asks whether the described evaluation could actually have falsified the claim and explicitly zeroes out enumeration of settings/resources, making it a genuine test of evidential discriminative power.
final.parent: Count of enumerated evaluation settings and resource markers

final.name: Theory-to-Algorithm Coherence
final.audit_justification: Requiring that theory actually determine or predict the algorithm's behavior, versus theory and method being unrelated decorations, is a genuine coherence-of-content judgement.
